# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::checkbox`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

Checkbox control with label. Built on the same four layers as the button (see `button.rs`): a
[`CheckboxLook`](checkbox.md#struct.CheckboxLook) and its settled values, [`paint`](checkbox.md#fn.paint), the Painter-API [`checkbox`](checkbox.md#fn.checkbox) and
[`Ui::checkbox`](../ui.md#method.Ui.checkbox).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/checkbox.rs:1`
